distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) record Phloeosinus camphoratus from Yunnan. Lin & Beaver (2021) provides the first Taiwan record, with multiple Nantou trap captures and a breeding series from Taichung. The reviewed synthesis therefore retains Yunnan and adds Taiwan.

host_note: 殷蕙芬等 (1984)/黄复生等 (2015) directly support Cinnamomum camphora in China. Lin & Beaver (2021) directly bred the species from Cinnamomum subavenium in Taiwan; both are promoted as current hosts. Cinnamomum iners is cited from older literature in the 2021 paper and is retained separately.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Phloeosinus camphoratus Tsai & Yin, 1964.

taxonomic_history.name: Phloeosinus camphoratus

nomenclature_note: Canonical identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone: Phloeosinus camphoratus Tsai & Yin, 1964, VSN_4002. The legacy profile body's Schedl, 1951 authorship is superseded by the canonical identity.
